name: Lord of Doors
source:
A quirky, emotional and tragic tale of love with cosmic horror.

Your wife is not feeling well, and you are trying your best to keep yourself together. Sometimes that feeling of sorrow and loss happens even before death ever comes. 

[From [url=https://studio-lemi.itch.io/lord-of-doors]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个关于宇宙恐怖的离奇、情感和悲剧的爱情故事。

你的妻子感觉不舒服，而你正在尽力让自己平静下来。有时，这种悲伤和失落的感觉甚至在死亡到来之前就发生了。

[来自[url=https://studio-lemi.itch.io/lord-of-doors]Itch.io[/url]]
